# MODULE_NAME behavior template

Status: Approved

Classification: Template; non-canonical example.

Copy useful sections only. Set the resulting document to Draft for review.

## Purpose

Describe the module's observable purpose.

## Responsibilities

List the behavior it owns and explicit non-responsibilities.

## Main features and rules

Describe stable operations, data, constraints, and edge cases. Label each relevant group Implemented, Partial, or Planned based on evidence.

## Dependencies and interfaces

Name collaborators and public contracts; link their registry entries.

## Persistence and lifecycle

Include only if relevant; describe state changes and recovery boundaries.

## Known limitations and evidence

Record discrepancies, source/test references, and unavailable checks. Link behavior, technical notes, and the product specification without copying their rules.
